position_margin.definition: min(iphi, 30-iphi, ieta, 85-ieta) in stored index units
position_margin.interpretation: Stored target-index ranges, not physical detector edges

budget.batch_order: CPU torch.Generator seed 20260924; one torch.randperm(train_count) per epoch; generator advances across epochs
budget.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR, stepped once after each optimizer update
budget.suite_limit_scope: wall-clock ceiling shared by all eight runs and their diagnostics, not a per-model allowance

periodic_reference.timing_note: CPU least-squares fit; not a GPU neural training time

time_to_target.condition: Both errors <= reference * 1.02 at the same evaluation
time_to_target.timing_resolution: initial evaluation, then epoch-end observations only
time_to_target.included_costs: minibatch indexing, CPU-to-GPU batch transfer, forward/backward computation, gradient checks and optimizer/scheduler updates
time_to_target.excluded_costs: initial data loading and preparation, validation, checkpoint persistence and Drive transfers
time_to_target.interpretation: First observed crossing, not exact continuous crossing time; no interpolation, no requirement for sustained attainment

paired_comparison.method: paired iid event bootstrap, percentile intervals, linear quantiles
limitations: Conditional on these trained and validation-selected checkpoints.
No correction for checkpoint selection or exploratory method selection.
Does not estimate variability across training seeds or independent runs.
Assumes events are independent sampling units; not a grouped bootstrap.
Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Not a reserved-test evaluation or independent confirmation.

verification.artifact_scope: Existing import and paired reports identify checkpoint/prediction bytes. Optional --run-dir rechecks those files and prints a receipt.

limitations: One training seed; exploratory validation selected both the model and its epoch.
No final-test performance or universal architecture ranking is established.
Event-bootstrap intervals do not estimate variation across training seeds.
The energy correction factor is bounded to exp(-0.1)..exp(0.1).
The selected model is trained on clean deposits and fails under strong added noise.
Stored position units have no certified physical crystal-center interpretation.
CPU/CUDA replay discrepancies remain; T4 results define this reference.
The existing Docker demonstration evaluates the original CNN, not this Transformer.
Masked pretraining and its benefit have not been measured.
